verdict.rationale: Rippling advertises several narrow AI features (AI-built reports/dashboards, AI review of dependent documents, AI-driven employee Q&A, and a natural-language prompt for headcount dashboards), which show some capability to delegate specific tasks to embedded AI. However, there is no evidence of a unified, general-purpose 'AI assistant' that can be delegated broad, cross-platform tasks the way an agentic assistant would. Missing for 10: a single named AI assistant entity, evidence of multi-step task delegation/execution, and independent/hands-on confirmation of its behavior beyond marketing copy.
